scope: Homepage, platform, records, five outcomes, five sectors, ID and ID demo, security, physical QR mockup. These are capture instructions, not claims that new real demos have been supplied.

existing_asset.status: Existing role-setup capture used on approved pages; inspect freshness/anonymisation against current build before final publication. Other platform assets require the same review.

capture_rules: Use a seeded demo organisation and fictional workers; remove real names, emails, documents, IDs, addresses and tokens.
Capture real supported behaviour and version/date each asset. Do not simulate absent features as product proof.
Record desktop at 1440×900 and mobile at 390×844; export 16:10 desktop posters and native phone aspect ratios. Crop deliberately; never stretch.
Use muted captioned video with a poster, explicit play/pause, reduced-motion support and a static fallback. No autoplay audio.
Keep hero previews compact. Place longer clips in the matching chapter; use the existing data-demo-slot attributes to locate them.
Document which states and permissions each capture establishes. Use genuine client evidence only after permission; Certifyd has no clients/testimonials to use now.

Connected worker record overview.format: 15–25 second captioned company-workspace clip, still poster at 16:10
show: Open a fictional worker from the workforce view
Show role requirements, shared personal evidence and company-held records
Follow one item to its evidence and next review action
Connected worker record overview.boundary: A connected view does not imply the organisation owns all personal documents or that every status is independently verified.

show: Choose a role in the company workspace
Show the evidence requested for that role
Show an invitation and a worker who has not yet supplied all evidence
Role requirements and onboarding.boundary: Use the actual supported onboarding flow. Do not replace unimplemented invitations/import with animation presented as product.

Import and first-group review.format: 30-second desktop walkthrough with a sanitised sample spreadsheet and a downloadable example template
show: Show the accepted import or assisted-import method
Map person, role and record fields through the real supported process
Demonstrate duplicate/missing-field handling and first-group review before wider rollout
Import and first-group review.boundary: Confirm self-serve versus assisted import. Do not imply automatic mapping or validation without a working screen and repeatable result.

Workforce overview and evidence drill-do.format: 20–30 second desktop clip; 16:10 overview and detail posters
show: Filter missing evidence and pending reviews
Open one worker record from the overview
Show the document, its source, status and reviewer’s next action
Workforce overview and evidence drill-do.boundary: An upload is not a completed review. Avoid fabricated workforce totals or claimed reduction in compliance risk.

Expiry, review dates and history.format: 20-second desktop clip covering due and renewed states
show: Show a real expiry field and a separate organisation review date
Open an approaching-date record
Add replacement evidence through the real workflow and inspect history
Expiry, review dates and history.boundary: A credential expiry date is not automatically a statutory follow-up date. DBS certificates have no official expiry date.

Personal and organisation ownership.format: Paired desktop and mobile captures, shown sequentially rather than a three-column montage
show: Worker opens personal credentials in the app
Worker shares the relevant record for work
Organisation sees only shared evidence plus its own documents and review decision
Personal and organisation ownership.boundary: Verify permissions and what survives leaving an organisation. Do not suggest unrestricted access to the worker’s wallet.

show: Open a fictional personal ID document with masked identifying details
Share the relevant document through the actual permission flow
Show company access and the pending review; demonstrate removal/expiry only if actually supported
Worker app and scoped document sharing.boundary: Reuse of document evidence does not complete an employer’s required identity or right-to-work check. Do not display real passports, addresses or document numbers.

App scan, attendance and visit history.format: 15-second mobile arrival clip plus desktop attendance/history clip
show: Worker scans the assigned site code using the actual app
Manager sees the recorded person/site/time
Worker checks out and manager opens the retained visit record
App scan, attendance and visit history.boundary: A scan records an event. It does not alone prove uninterrupted presence, authorised work or prevent a live relay.

Homeowner shared profile.format: Worker-phone QR presentation followed by a homeowner browser capture
show: Tradesperson presents the real shared-profile QR
Homeowner scans without accessing private documents
Show person, company affiliation, role and credentials actually shared; include expired/unavailable/access-denied state
Homeowner shared profile.boundary: Confirm no-app versus app-required homeowner flow. Show the source/status of company affiliations and credentials; do not imply independent verification beyond actual checks.

Hardware and offline check-in.format: Real hardware macro shot, 10-second rotation clip, app scan, offline-to-synced event clip
show: Show actual enclosure and mounting scale beside a room door or check-in point
Record the display changing its authenticated code
Show a valid scan and rejected stale-code example under the implemented protocol
Turn off network in a sandbox, record a visit, reconnect and show the same event syncing once
Hardware and offline check-in.boundary: Validate device price, display type, rotation interval, clock drift/rollback, token signing/expiry, power draw and battery runtime. Demonstrate offline verification/time trust and replay/relay limits. No inferred “full visit presence”.

Access and data handling.format: Desktop permission walkthrough and plain-language data diagram
show: Invite a reviewer with limited role access
Compare permitted and denied evidence views
Remove access and inspect an audit entry where supported
Access and data handling.boundary: Use implemented controls. Confirm encryption, storage region, retention, processors and deletion with actual system evidence before adding certifications or security badges.
